mapper.sql: id, name, description, display_order, active, created_at, updated_at

gm.id, gm.retreat_group_id, rg.name AS retreat_group_name, r.id AS participant_id, r.name AS participant_name, r.gender, r.birth_year, r.church_cell_department, r.church_cell_id, cc.name AS church_cell_name, mg.id AS middle_group_id, mg.name AS middle_group_name, gm.leader, gm.display_order AS member_display_order, gm.created_at, gm.updated_at

FROM retreat_group_members gm JOIN retreat_groups rg ON rg.id = gm.retreat_group_id JOIN registrations r ON r.id = gm.registration_id LEFT JOIN church_cells cc ON cc.id = r.church_cell_id LEFT JOIN church_middle_groups mg ON mg.id = cc.church_middle_group_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM retreat_groups ORDER BY display_order ASC, name ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retreat_groups (name, description, display_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE retreat_groups SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE retreat_groups SET active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY rg.display_order ASC, rg.name ASC, gm.display_order ASC, r.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retreat_group_members (retreat_group_id, registration_id, leader, display_order) SELECT #{groupId}, #{participantId}, #{leader}, COALESCE(MAX(display_order) + 1, 0) FROM retreat_group_members WHERE retreat_group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE retreat_group_members SET leader = FALSE, updated_at = now() WHERE retreat_group_id = #{groupId} AND leader = TRUE
UPDATE retreat_group_members SET display_order = CASE WHEN registration_id = #{participantId} THEN 0 ELSE display_order + 1 END, updated_at = now() WHERE retreat_group_id = #{groupId}
